story_overview: Tensions rise among a group including Isabella, Marco, and Paolo at a hidden cove, marked by tense conversations and emotional distress. The situation escalates with the arrival of Vittorio and a Guardia di Finanza patrol, leading to an intense investigation where the group is questioned at the Guardia office.

video_prompts:
Vittorio: Middle-aged man with gray, slicked-back hair and a mustache, wearing a gray military uniform with yellow details on the collar and shoulders
Luca: Man wearing a white t-shirt, tan pants, and a white sailor hat, with bare feet
Isabella: Woman with dark, styled hair, wearing a colorful sleeveless patterned dress, barefoot
Marco: Man with dark curly hair wearing a plain green t-shirt, barefoot
Daytime at The Hidden Cove. Isabella and Marco are near the base of a large cliff. With a concerned expression, Isabella walks barefoot across the rocky shore towards Vittorio and Luca, who are approaching from the background. Marco watches the interaction for a moment before slowly starting to follow.

Paolo: Man wearing a men's short-sleeved collared polo shirt with a pattern of blue and white stripes
the colorful sundress: Sleeveless sundress with a colorful pattern

Daytime at The Hidden Cove. By the water's edge, Paolo, wearing the striped polo shirt, gestures while speaking to Vittorio, Luca, wearing the white t-shirt and tan pants, and Isabella, wearing the colorful sundress, who listen intently.

Wide shot in The Hidden Cove, where a group stands together on the sunny, rocky shore. Paolo, wearing the striped polo shirt, talks animatedly, gesturing with his hands. Beside him, Vittorio stands with his hands on his hips, listening intently. Isabella, wearing the colorful sundress, and Luca, wearing the white t-shirt, tan pants, and sailor hat, stand nearby, observing the conversation.

At The Hidden Cove, Vittorio, with a serious expression, talks to Isabella, who looks away pensively. They stand near the water with tall, layered rock cliffs behind them. Luca walks away in the background out of focus.

Giovanni: Man with a mustache wearing a black long-sleeved shirt

In The Hidden Cove, Giovanni, Isabella, and Marco stand together on the rocky shore. Giovanni talks intently to Isabella, wearing the colorful sundress, who listens and then smiles as she replies. Marco stands slightly apart from them, looking out at the water.

Medium close-up of Giovanni and Isabella on a boat in The Hidden Cove. Giovanni looks angry and points his finger accusingly at Isabella. Isabella, wearing the colorful sundress, listens intently with a serious expression as the boat sits in the rocky cove.
Medium close-up of Giovanni and Isabella standing on a boat in The Hidden Cove. Giovanni, wearing the dark blue shirt, speaks to Isabella, who is wearing the colorful sundress, as the boat drifts.

On the shore of The Hidden Cove, Paolo, wearing the striped polo shirt, is crying hysterically. Next to him, Luca, wearing the white t-shirt and tan pants, looks on with concern, attempting to talk to his distraught friend.

Long shot from behind a large rock in The Hidden Cove. Giovanni watches from the shoreline as the white speedboat speeds across the bright blue sea on a clear, sunny day, leaving a prominent white wake.

At The Hidden Cove during the day, Isabella, wearing the colorful sundress, stands beside Giovanni, who wears the dark blue shirt. Their gazes drift up and away, their expressions becoming serious and focused as they observe something approaching from off-screen.

Wide shot in The Hidden Cove. A group of men wearing the matching sailor uniforms, led by Vittorio, disembark from the grey patrol boat docked at the rocky shore and run across the beach toward the cliffs.

Wide shot of The Hidden Cove, where Vittorio and Giovanni stand on the rocky shore, watching the activity below. A group of men wearing the matching sailor uniforms runs across the beach, carrying the military rifles. In the distance, a man and a woman steady the wooden motorboat in the shallow water.
Luca forcefully pulls a terrified Paolo down to the ground. They crouch in fear together, hiding behind a large boulder next to the stack of cigarette boxes.

Nearby, Luca and Marco sit together at the office desk, speaking quietly to each other.
